changes.title: Ocean heat waves linked with poorer health among children in coastal communities
changes.summary: Marine heat waves—periods of abnormally warm ocean temperatures—may have negative health effects on children who live in coastal communities in low- and middle-income countries, according to a study led by researchers at Penn State and the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill.

changes.title: North Carolina G.O.P. Picks Replacement for Candidate Plagued by Scandal
changes.summary: Representative Chuck Edwards dropped his re-election bid amid sexual harassment allegations. His replacement, Jennifer Balkcom, has about 80 days to campaign.
